model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training rewards of different reinforcement learning agents over the course of training steps. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels spaced every 50 units. The y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.4, with tick labels spaced every 0.1 unit. A solid blue line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” agent, which begins at a reward of approximately 0.0, gradually increases to a maximum reward of approximately 0.3 near the 300 steps, and then maintains a relatively stable value around 0.3. A red dashed line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” agent, which begins at approximately 0.0, increases to a maximum reward of approximately 0.2 near the 200 steps, and subsequently declines to approximately 0.1 at the end of the plotted range. A light orange shaded area represents the uncertainty around each line, indicating the standard deviation of the rewards at each step. Finally, a solid brown line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” agent, starting at approximately 0.0, attaining a maximum reward of around 0.1 at the 100 steps, and decreasing to approximately 0.05 at the end of the plotted range.
